widgets_values: Create a 20-second realistic live-action action-trailer sequence at post-rain dusk. A coat-wearing protagonist escapes pursuers by sprinting and leaping across wet skyscraper rooftops; make every jump fluid and dangerous. Use hard cuts on musical beats, distinct camera angles, wind, footsteps, city ambience, and a restrained cinematic score. Preserve premium practical-film texture, anamorphic depth, volumetric city fog, and natural body motion. No text, subtitles, logos, animation, or overly-CG rendering.

widgets_values:
# DiffusionGemma Director → native MiniMax-H3 (T2VA)

1. Replace the creative brief at upper left.
2. Set Duration seconds. The same value feeds the Director profile and native H3 frame calculation.
3. Queue the workflow. DiffusionGemma unloads after writing the H3 prompt, freeing VRAM before video generation.

This sample is set to 20 seconds and 25 sampling steps. At 24 fps, 20 seconds resolves to 481 valid H3 frames (about 20.04 seconds) because H3 uses a 17k+5 temporal grid.

The Director's dedicated minimax_h3_prompt output branches to Generated MiniMax-H3 prompt for inspection and passes through the Generation Gate before MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo. The gate also receives readiness and splitter metadata, so a strict grounding failure cannot reach H3. H3 validation / blocked reasons displays the splitter metadata. Resolution outputs feed width and height at 0.4 MP, multiple 32, 16:9.

Short clips in the 4–15 second range remain a useful creative default, but this native path is not artificially clamped to that range. Its node accepts up to 3600 frames. Longer clips require proportionally more generation time and VRAM.
